description: This file contains classes and functions for manual overlap scheduling and bucketing of collective operations in a PyTorch FX graph, specifically for overlapping communication primitives like all-gather and reduce-scatter based on user-defined module plans.

classes.name: ManualOverlapPreservingBucketer
classes.description: A bucketer class that groups collective operations based on user specifications, supporting custom bucketing of all-gather and reduce-scatter nodes.

classes.name: ManualOverlapScheduler
classes.description: A scheduler class that manages manual bucketing and reordering of collective nodes according to user-defined module plans, enabling overlapping communication operations.

methods.name: manual_overlap_bucketing
methods.description: Main function that applies manual overlap bucketing and reordering to a FX GraphModule based on user-specified module plans.
